text: {"version":1,"kind":"analytics","reading":"Rank players by points per game (total points divided by games played) in games dated in calendar year 2017, restricted to players with at least 20 games played, now also showing rebounds per game and assists per game for those same players, top 10 by player identity with player name displayed.","measures":[{"ref":"column:dev.player_game_stats.played","aggregation":"sum","alias":"games_played"},{"derived":{"kind":"ratio","numerator":"column:dev.player_game_stats.pts","denominator":"column:dev.player_game_stats.played","numeratorAggregation":"sum","denominatorAggregation":"sum"},"alias":"points_per_game"},{"derived":{"kind":"ratio","numerator":"column:dev.player_game_stats.reb","denominator":"column:dev.player_game_stats.played","numeratorAggregation":"sum","denominatorAggregation":"sum"},"alias":"rebounds_per_game"},{"derived":{"kind":"ratio","numerator":"column:dev.player_game_stats.ast","denominator":"column:dev.player_game_stats.played","numeratorAggregation":"sum","denominatorAggregation":"sum"},"alias":"assists_per_game"}],"groupBy":[{"ref":"dimension:player_game_stats.player_id","role":"key"}],"display":["dimension:player_game_stats.player_name"],"filters":[{"ref":"measure:0","op":"gte","values":[20],"source":"question"}],"ordering":{"ref":"measure:1","direction":"desc"},"limit":10,"time":{"ref":"dimension:player_game_stats.game_date","window":{"start":"2017-01-01","end":"2018-01-01","expression":"calendar year 2017"}},"expectedShape":"ranking","unresolved":[],"provenance":{"column:dev.player_game_stats.played":"inherited","column:dev.player_game_stats.pts":"inherited","column:dev.player_game_stats.reb":"q:rebounds per game","column:dev.player_game_stats.ast":"q:assists per game","dimension:player_game_stats.player_id":"inherited","dimension:player_game_stats.player_name":"inherited","measure:0":"inherited","dimension:player_game_stats.game_date":"inherited"}}
